none: PAS NLM-4E6D94: Roman Coin: Nummus of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Gloria Romanorum issue of 350-352, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust possibly mantled right; possibly a letter [?A] in left field. Obverse inscription: DN MAG[---]. Reverse description: Emperor galloping right spearing barbarian. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA RO]MANORVM. Diameter: 23.0mm, Weight: 4.20gms, die axis: 6
